message.jaymospowers.body_menu.nothing: There's nothing you can do for %s just now.
body_tip.jaymospowers.body_menu.title: Someone down
body_tip.jaymospowers.body_menu: Tap %1$s on someone downed, tied up or out cold to pick what to do: revive, untie, lift, go through their pockets. Hold %1$s to drag them. To revive them yourself, kneel beside them (hold %2$s, scroll down, keep still) and hold %1$s, or pick Revive and you kneel on your own.
body_tip.jaymospowers.execute.title: Finishing
body_tip.jaymospowers.execute: Hold %1$s on someone downed to execute them. Every kind of weapon does it its own way, and bare hands snap the neck from their head.
body_tip.jaymospowers.lasso.title: The lasso
body_tip.jaymospowers.lasso: Hold %1$s to whirl it and let go to throw. Walk in to wind the rope, back off to drag. At a person's side, hold %1$s to hogtie them; then tap %1$s on them to untie, lift or search them.
body_tip.jaymospowers.downed.title: You're down
body_tip.jaymospowers.downed: Hold %1$s to get back up if your wounds let you. Too badly hurt to rise, holding it gives up and you die, so wait for help instead.
body_tip.jaymospowers.wall_sit.title: A wall beside you
body_tip.jaymospowers.wall_sit: Press %1$s to sit up against the wall. Sat there, hold %2$s to push yourself up it to your feet: it works even with limbs too hurt to stand on, just slower.
